shots.name: claims-overview
shots.caption: Four factions' claims drawn over a BlueMap top-down render. Each faction's chunks are merged into outlined polygons in its own colour.
shots.alt: BlueMap top-down map of a Minecraft world with red, green, light blue and dark blue outlined polygons marking four factions' claimed chunks

shots.name: claims-perspective
shots.caption: The same claims in BlueMap's 3D perspective view.
shots.alt: BlueMap 3D perspective view of forested hills and a river with translucent coloured claim polygons laid over the terrain

shots.name: claim-popup
shots.caption: Clicking a claim opens its label, set by label-format (default "Faction: %faction%").
shots.alt: Close-up of a red faction claim on BlueMap with a popup reading Faction: Ashford

shots.name: marker-menu
shots.caption: The Medieval Factions Claims marker set in BlueMap's marker menu, where viewers can toggle it.
shots.alt: BlueMap side menu listing a Medieval Factions Claims marker set beside the map

shots.name: claims-phone
shots.caption: The overlay on a phone-width browser.
shots.alt: BlueMap on a phone-sized screen showing the coloured faction claim polygons over the map

shots.name: y-level
shots.caption: Briarwood's claim with bluemap.y-level at the default 70 and at 100.
shots.alt: BlueMap close-up of a green faction claim over forest
